summary: Parkevtate Vosianc reiterates his January 2026 buy on Pfizer (PFE), focusing on its dividend appeal. He highlights Pfizer's use of AI to accelerate drug discovery, optimize manufacturing yields, and improve commercial sales effectiveness, calling AI in drug discovery a major bullish opportunity. Management guides to high-single-digit revenue growth for 2028-2033, a significant acceleration. Revenue spiked from ~$45B to over $100B during COVID before settling near $63.7B, and operating margins peaked near 40%, troughed around 3%, and recovered to ~26% — with 20-30% a reasonable long-run expectation excluding the pandemic. Returns on invested capital disappointed relative to Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk, which benefit from booming GLP-1 weight-loss drugs; Pfizer has weight-loss treatments in its pipeline likely to reach market within a couple of years, and he notes room for new entrants. At a forward P/E of 9.6, he says Pfizer deserves a discount to the S&P 500 given anemic revenue growth and volatile margins. His DCF gives ~$50 fair value versus a $28 market price — over 80% upside. He owns Eli Lilly and is watching Novo closely. Call: PFE BUY, a low-risk-tolerance, long-term dividend holding that adds diversification.
title: Is Pfizer an Excellent Dividend Stock to Buy? | PFE Stock Analysis
